name: eight-node-rdma-pool
description: Eight compute nodes sharing one RDMA pool, running a synthetic KV-cache decode workload under frequency-aware tiering. Exercises multi-node pool contention over a star fabric. Single pool, no peer links, no expert/MoE modeling, no faults.
assumptions: RDMA values are starting presets from docs/HARDWARE-MODELS.md, not measurements of a specific fabric.
The workload is synthetic KV-cache decode from generic GQA geometry, not a captured trace and not an MoE expert model.
Results are relative comparisons between policies until the scenario is calibrated against measured RDMA latency distributions.

provenance.source: docs/HARDWARE-MODELS.md local DRAM preset, capacity overridden for this test
provenance.method: Latency and bandwidth use the local DRAM preset. Capacity is deliberately reduced to 384 MiB so one 4096-token KV cache (about 512 MiB) cannot fit and must spill to the pool.
